title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Calls per Customer and Separate Invoicing
content:
**Rule.** Under Repair and Emergency Service Calls a customer may have any number of service calls over time. More than one call may be open at once when the calls concern different units. There is no per-customer cap on calls. Each call is invoiced on its own, and its balance is settled on that call.

## What this means at the desk

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result |
|---|---|
| A customer has had nine calls over the years and books a tenth | Allowed; there is no per-customer cap |
| A customer has an open call on the furnace and asks for a call on the air conditioner | A second open call is allowed, because it concerns a different unit |
| A customer pays toward one call's invoice | The payment settles the balance of that call; each call keeps its own invoice and balance |

## Basis questions

**Can one payment be spread across two open calls?** No. Each call is invoiced on its own, and its balance is settled on that call.

**Is there a limit on the number of calls a household may book in a year?** No per-customer cap applies.
